description:
Our planet contains numerous geographic and archaeological anomalies that continue to baffle researchers, defying easy scientific explanation. From physics-defying natural phenomena to ancient ruins built with incomprehensible precision, these locations test the boundaries of modern human knowledge.

What you'll learn in this video:
► How massive geoglyphs like the Nazca Lines were etched into the Peruvian desert
► The baffling physics behind the moving sailing stones in Death Valley
► The real history and science surrounding the infamous Bermuda Triangle
► The origins of the persistent low-frequency Taos Hum heard in New Mexico
